integrity: The exact semiprime criterion is classical and is not presented as new. The new claim is the asymptotic count of its exceptions. The proof separates fixed moduli, a Brun--Titchmarsh tail, and a large-modulus elementary tail. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic concerns squarefree semiprimes only and does not give an effective remainder term. Historical sources from 1947 and 1948 predate the stored date, but the inspected records did not provide exact public calendar days for them; 2014-01-19 is the earliest exact public source date verified from an archival electronic source.
title: The exceptional law for noncyclic squarefree semiprimes
